profile.purpose: Record the published three configured co-folding predictor modes, optimization, and a five-seed uniform rescore as a reference configuration. ESMFold2-Full and ESMFold2-Fast are two modes of one predictor lineage.
profile.production_scoring_reason: This file records a partial reference configuration. ESMFold2-Full and ESMFold2-Fast have deployed applications; Protenix v2 still needs an immutable official artifact receipt, qualified CUDA image, and completed validation.

published_predictor_deviations.reason: ESMFold2-Full was not run. This profile is a reference configuration and does not dispatch a deployed campaign.
ESMFold2-Fast was not run. This profile is a reference configuration and does not dispatch a deployed campaign.
Protenix v2 was not run. No qualified Protenix v2 CUDA image, immutable weights record, and completed runtime validation are bundled for this route.

cost_basis.note: Ten settled Modal waves of 20 designs each settled between USD 0.03147459 and USD 0.17142222 per wave. This rate divides the dearest wave by its 20 designs, so a ceiling refuses rather than under-quotes.

No Modal figure exists for Genie3. The two recorded observations are modeled RunPod estimates that disagree by about thirty times per backbone: about USD 0.31 for 25 backbones on an L40, and about USD 1.50 for 4 candidates across 9 pod fires on an L40S. Neither prices this arm on the provider a campaign dispatches to.

One settled Modal CPU run produced 2 validated 80-residue sequences for USD 0.00099581 in 3.102723 seconds. This rate divides that amount by 2, so it spreads container startup across both sequences. The C-alpha checkpoint is the same wrapper on the same container, and no run has timed it, so the rate is carried rather than measured.

The one recorded SolubleMPNN run, a single design on a RunPod L40, carries no separately recorded charge. The ProteinMPNN Modal amount prices a different model on a different provider and is not carried across.
One settled Modal CPU run produced 2 validated 80-residue sequences for USD 0.00099581 in 3.102723 seconds. This rate divides that amount by 2, so it spreads container startup across both sequences.

One settled ESMFold2-Full fold on a Modal L40S. Larger settled Modal waves priced lower per fold, at USD 0.88450719 for 32 designs and USD 0.38812749 for 16. This rate takes the dearest measured fold.
One settled ESMFold2-Fast fold on a Modal L40S. A four-fold run on the same machine settled at USD 0.01914518 in total, so this cold single fold is the dearer per-fold rate and this rate takes it.

The one recorded Protenix v2 figure, about USD 1.95, is a modeled estimate on a non-Modal hosted H100 at the USD 4.50 per hour planning rate. The record files it under deploy-time cold starts, because a cold worker spent most of the 1,561 seconds installing its runtime and downloading its checkpoint. It does not measure a per-design rate, and multiplying it by a design count would state a cost the record does not support.

stages.description: Prepare target chains, residue maps, and site definitions.

outputs._note: The RFdiffusion3 specification the backbone generator reads. The published name carries the target id and bind_rfd3_specification_output sets publish_path from the primary target, because a publish path is a literal in the resolved graph. The attempt-directory name does not, because target_prep_parser renders only attempt_dir, phase and stage_id. It declares no required_fields: derive_specification keys the document by campaign and target, so its top-level key is not a fixed name.

stages.description: Verify every enabled adapter, revision, model, environment, and weight set.
Stage one unpaired target-chain alignment per target into the cache every MSA-consuming arm reads.
Run every registered control through the configured predictors and measurements.
Generate the RFdiffusion backbone arm.
Generate the Genie 3 backbone arm. Genie 3 writes a C-alpha trace and no sequence, so a sequence designer assigns residues downstream.
Design SolubleMPNN sequences for the RFdiffusion backbone arm.
Design ProteinMPNN sequences for the RFdiffusion backbone arm.
Design ProteinMPNN sequences for the Genie 3 backbone arm. The arm is a C-alpha trace, so this stage carries --ca-only and loads the C-alpha checkpoint.
Join co-design and inverse-folding outputs into one candidate lineage table.
Apply composition, duplicate, and sequence-liability checks.
Apply target-chain sequence mimicry and model-likelihood checks.
Run the one-seed ESMFold2 screen.
Run the one-seed ESMFold2-Fast screen.
Run the one-seed Protenix v2 screen.
Normalize screen confidence, pose consistency, target-site contacts, and interface geometry.
Apply control separation, score gates, and diversity rules to choose optimization parents.
Create the round summary and a bounded optimization decision from promoted candidates.
Run validated optimization rounds and preserve parent-child lineage.
Run the five-seed ESMFold2 uniform rescore.
Run the five-seed ESMFold2-Fast uniform rescore.
Run the five-seed Protenix v2 uniform rescore.
Verify the exact predictor-seed matrix and write the normalized observation table.
Normalize each predictor, apply the 4:1 score, enforce controls, and select the generator-balanced portfolio.
Render the final-ranked predicted complexes as overview and interface-closeup pictures.
Verify receipts, output hashes, stage completion, score coverage, and selected-candidate paths.
Build viewer scripts and render thumbnails for ranked designs.
